disposition.reason: Docket 169-12-16 Vtec is an appeal of an Act 250 permit issued by the District #4 Environmental Commission to VTrans for a highway interchange (the Diverging Diamond Interchange at I-89 Exit 16), not a municipal land-use decision, and the project is nonresidential road infrastructure.

evidence.quote: RL Vallee, Inc. (Vallee) and Timberlake Associates, LLC (Timberlake) appeal Act 250 permit #4C1271

issued jointly on November 28, 2016 by the District #4 Environmental Commission to the Vermont Agency of Transportation (VTrans) for the construction of the Diverging Diamond Interchange and related improvements (the Project).

Timberlake seeks to appeal an Act 250 permit granted to the Vermont Agency of Transportation (VTrans) to construct a Diverging Diamond Interchange and related improvements (the DDI project) at I-89 Exit 16 in Colchester.

judgments.note: Every document headed 169-12-16 Vtec (docs 3, 9-13) describes an appeal of Act 250 permit #4C1271 issued by the District #4 Environmental Commission to VTrans for a highway interchange; no municipal decision and no housing. Shared decisions with 50-6-16 Vtec (stormwater permit) and 122-10-16 Vtec (MS4) concern separate state-permit dockets; nothing taken from them. Read in part; scope established early per instructions.
Act 250 District Commission permit appeal, which the guide classifies as no.
Project is a road interchange and related improvements; no housing terms appear in the case text.
